svg.desc: Seven named display facets explain existing activation step 22 without adding milestones, a completion denominator or an effort percentage. PLAN, Permission + planning, is source-landed: permission d3f846916e121b18d57e9979c700aaa1000d4969, durable claim 4f9185c and private planning 4fc61c341420b96e785973f5c3cdd3c49748b97f. RECORDS, Durable stage records; IO, Guarded transports; and SQL, Grant / reserve / SQL, are source-landed in .183 commit 8f1b9a1c8b2cd6f31eac87ac169636ec3280b965. COMPLETE, Completion continuation, is source-landed in .184 commit 829064f27f82148de4bc41542631df0fa0aa6ff9: actual original-bound caller/server completion, durable raw4 retention and public signed-control admission, without public AES custody. RELEASE, Consume / release continuation, remains in progress and partial. Its five named connections are Prepare / export, source-landed in .185 commit fbdb6461454e4e3e47e064fe798497bf5de3d67a; Authorization, source-landed in .186 commit 93e0142f3b440682305a9d2bd937a441b3050423; Grant / reserve / SQL, source-landed in .187 commit f3b7781e2c5a83333ecf4b105fca37115cea09ce; Completion, todo; and Protected handoff, todo. These are connections inside RELEASE, not additional milestones; the remaining consume connections are distinct from the already landed activation SQL and COMPLETE facets. HTTP, Public route + cookie, remains todo. Names and written statuses are visible without color or hover. Criteria are in the activation-dispatch-detail source ledger. Existing activation totals remain 21/26 source-landed, 1 active and 4 other open; project 34/46 and production 0/6 verified are unchanged. Private SQL observations do not close public dispatch or authorize completion, token release or cookie issuance. Source only: unbuilt, unexecuted and unprovisioned, with no deployed or current-session claim.
